answer: To mitigate Sybil attacks, an economy of AI agents can employ a voting-based mechanism where agents must complete a series of tasks to verify their identity before participating in decision-making voyages. Each task requires agents to demonstrate a unique delta between their current and previous state, effectively creating an inlet of transparency. This approach requires agents to maintain a history of their actions, making it costly for an attacker to create multiple fake identities, as they would need to replicate this history without being detected.
